entities.summary: Davon Malcolm Reed is a Puerto Rican professional basketball player for the Santeros de Aguada of the Baloncesto Superior Nacional (BSN). After playing college basketball for the Miami Hurricanes, he was selected with the 32nd pick in the 2017 NBA draft by the Phoenix Suns.
